senses.d: A sheet material typically used for writing on or printing on (or as a non-waterproof container), usually made by draining cellulose fibres from a suspension in water.
ex: Draw on the paper! Not on the walls!

senses.d: A written document that reports scientific or academic research and is usually subjected to peer review before publication in a scientific journal (as a journal article or the manuscript for one) or in the proceedings of a scientific or academic meeting (such as a conference, workshop, or symposium).
ex: Their team published a paper in the leading journal of their field, and its widespread impact elevated the reputation of their university department.
